text:
incidents-bot: PAGER — cont-batch streaming path p99 > 650ms for 15m, p95 > 300ms. SLO breach detected. Region: eu-west-1. Paging oncall. Please ack.

oncall-ash: Acked. I'm on it. @samir @eng-sre can you triage the streaming batcher path?

samir: Looking now. Quick glance at batcher metrics shows pack ratio spike + long odd-length sequences. Mixed seqlen packing causing large effective batches and KV churn.

samir: ```
batcher_streaming_pack_ratio{zone="eu-west-1"} 0.78
batcher_p99_latency{path="streaming"} 820
streaming_stall_count 1120
```

megan: I'll draft a status update. How many customers impacted and any 5xxs?

eng-sre: No 5xxs observed — pure tail latency. Proposal: temporary mitigation: reduce max_batch_size and enable preemptive_shed on streamer nodes in eu-west-1, route heavy flows to fallback model variant. Tradeoff: throughput drop ~10-15%.

oncall-ash: Ok. Do the changes. What's the exact command?

samir: Use the control plane config API. Example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/config \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"service":"streaming","region":"eu-west-1","overrides":{"max_batch_size":8,"preemptive_shed":true}}'
```

eng-sre: Applying patch to streamer config and restarting pods (kubectl rollout restart). Also toggling flow-control factor to 0.8 to reduce pack buildup.

infra-bot: Deploy started: rollout/streamer-eu-west1 (deploy id: d7f3c1). Watching pod restarts.

runtime-lead: Note: this will reduce peak throughput by ~12%. Acceptable for mitigation?

megan: Acceptable. Customer-impact: 4 high-volume customers in EU. I'll post a short advisory now and DMed the account owners. ETA update 10m.

oncall-ash: Patch landed on 3/6 streamer nodes, restart completed. Monitoring metrics.

samir: Quick metric pull after change: ```
# run: curl -s http://metrics.internal/eu-west1/streaming | jq .latency.p99
Before: 820
After: 240
# streaming_stall_count decreased ~70% in last 90s
```

eng-sre: Confirming p99 ~230ms, p95 ~120ms now. Streaming stalls dropped. Rolling routing changes back to normal but keeping preemptive_shed=true for 30m to stabilize.

megan: Statuspage published: "Mitigation in progress — latency reduced; investigating root cause. Updates every 30min." link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2758886666

oncall-ash: :thumbsup: Leaving monitoring on this. I'll create a postmortem ticket and include packer/seqlen histograms. Tagging @runtime-lead @eng-sre for deeper root cause.

customer-success-sara: Notifying impacted customers via direct channels now; will escalate if any ask for rollback.

incidents-bot: Incident updated: severity -> sev2. Event count logged: 175. Pager cleared for oncall.

samir: Quick notes for postmortem: collect pack size distribution, seqlen histogram, kv-cache eviction rate, and scheduler fairness logs. Suspect mixed-length traffic spike and greedy packer window.

runtime-lead: Agreed. We'll run a canary with adjusted pack-window heuristics and re-evaluate.

megan: I'll follow up with a customer-facing timeline after 1h.

oncall-ash: Closing loop for now. If p99 creeps up again, page eng-sre immediately.

eng-sre: Logged runbook step: if p99 > 400ms for 5m, toggle preemptive_shed OR set max_batch_size=6 and escalate.

megan: thanks everyone — good coordination.
